# Existing API feedback follow-up

This is an independent source repair above frozen PR25. It does not replace the shipping input or gate Neo's basic preview access. The fixes are at `2d653f3885babcb9a8e78ae01d174d4fab50ed3a` on `repair/capiro-existing-api-feedback-20261014`. PR25 remains `257cf5b5db673b31c98264f9da33759c68066ba4`; its qualified image source remains `5ca42049325881782bc9d2ac557450d642eccee8`. PR23/24 and the separate read-only work are preserved. No merge or deployment occurred.

Shipping should continue using the [frozen functional profile](https://github.com/neo-capiro/capiro-frontend/blob/257cf5b5db673b31c98264f9da33759c68066ba4/docs/functional-preview-20261014/PROFILE.json) and [existing source/archive handoff](https://github.com/neo-capiro/capiro-frontend/blob/257cf5b5db673b31c98264f9da33759c68066ba4/docs/functional-preview-20261014/HANDOFF.md). This follow-up has no new shipping configuration or image. Review and select it separately before any later deployment.

## Confirmed defects and bounded fixes

An upstream 404 cannot distinguish a missing endpoint, missing record or deliberately hidden resource. The Portfolio proxy previously exposed framework text such as `Cannot GET ...`; the fixed-operation gateway described every 404 as a missing record. Both now retain HTTP 404 and say: **The requested action or record is unavailable from the current service.** Neither claims deletion, authorization, an empty result or successful persistence. Authentication, status handling outside 404, route admission, origins, cancellation, schemas and the two transport owners remain unchanged.

The ordered-owner editor also rendered a blank Primary assignment after its initial source read failed. It now renders owner cards only with a successful current read or an explicitly retained draft. The existing error/retry controls, disabled Save, versions, order and interrupted-write recovery remain intact. There is no fallback to the legacy Primary-only writer.

The failing baseline has 12 transport/behavior failures and three mounted browser failures against PR25. The same assertions pass after the repair. Existing objective/owner/calendar tests and all nine prior newsletter browser cases survive. Two additional newsletter cases prove that missing revision/staging routes cannot report success, enable staging without a revision, or automatically replay a failed staging request after reload.

## Backend evidence and affected actions

The source finding is [backend PR3 at `3509438f7f0c39c6da4db8a94b74c816211491b4`](https://github.com/neo-capiro/capiro-backend/blob/3509438f7f0c39c6da4db8a94b74c816211491b4/docs/preview-existing-api-compatibility-20261014/FINDING.md), blob `041f0e4d6a15fe73a4bb16160fb956d0d5a4c2c8`. It inspected `capirov2` main at `4be13b0b1ed0f2f3fa014040eedbb2fc2c27dace`. The four candidate API families below are absent from that source. This is not proof of the currently deployed backend image. Ordinary existing client APIs remain present; candidate contracts must not be silently substituted for them.

| Candidate family                 | Exact API contract                                                                                                                                                                      | Affected user actions and failure behavior                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| -------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Client objectives                | Core `GET/POST /api/clients/:clientId/objectives`; detail/update/delete use `?objectiveId=…` with `GET/PATCH/DELETE`; `POST /api/clients/:clientId/objectives/transition?objectiveId=…` | Client Overview objective summary; Objectives list, status filters, detail/deep links and objective pickers; New objective, Save draft, Request review, Confirm ready and Delete. Missing list/read stays an error, never an empty collection. Creation is disabled without the admitted source; failed writes cannot publish a saved objective or issue its next transition. Work destinations requiring a persisted objective are consequently unavailable. |
| Ordered account owners           | Core `GET/PUT /api/clients/:clientId/account-owners`; PUT carries `expectedVersion` and ordered `userIds`                                                                               | Account team → Manage owners: read/select/reorder/clear/save/read-back of Primary through Quaternary. A failed initial read shows an error and no blank assignment. Save remains disabled; explicit reread is available. A retained draft/uncertain attempt is preserved for review. Existing Primary index filters/options and legacy `/api/client-account-owners/:id` are separate; they do not implement the four-rank contract.                           |
| Saved newsletter staging         | Workspace `GET /workspace-api/drafts/:draftId/versions/:versionId/outreach-revision`; Core `POST /api/engagement/outreach-v3/sessions/:sessionId/newsletter-staging`                    | Workspace Newsletter → Stage in Outreach, selected saved-revision review, Stage, Recover original staging and resulting receipt link. Missing revision disables Stage. A rejected/uncertain stage preserves the original intent and reports failure without a success link or automatic replay. Ordinary manual newsletter draft saving uses distinct existing routes.                                                                                        |
| Federal Register effective dates | Core `GET /api/federal-register/effective-date-calendar?dateFrom=…&dateTo=…&page=…&limit=…`                                                                                             | Government-feed master Agenda at `/calendar` and `/modules/calendar`, including effective-date provenance/corrections. Failed source is visible; other available feeds may continue with that warning. Never claim a complete empty effective-date result. Ordinary Month/Week and client meeting Agenda do not depend on this route. No ingestion/refresh job is started by this repair.                                                                     |

## Exact candidate dependencies

These are unmerged source candidates, not basic-preview prerequisites or deployment approval. Their owner must qualify runtime, schema and data together before the associated feature can pass native acceptance.

- **Objectives:** [capirov2 PR2362](https://github.com/neo-capiro/capirov2/pull/2362), head `72bfea4c5f574c2d9dba63c6bbc63dac1c7e377e`. Contract `docs/portfolio-31/objectives-contract.md`, blob `ce1484af28c8a5c05d87c063bcff8113a5314631`. Reserved migration `20281011010000`. Expected-version transition receipts and existing client authorization are required. Source checks do not establish atomic revocation or native acceptance. No fallback to older Strategy objectives or invented IDs/versions.
- **Ordered owners:** [capirov2 PR2399](https://github.com/neo-capiro/capirov2/pull/2399), head `0783423aeaaa8b65f289d0927d605142816d8cfe`, accepted runtime `5f7308891e9bb3f0561804a0895b4372030c0d38`. Contract `docs/ordered-client-owners-20261012/CONTRACT.md`, blob `20e182294562cf8b9d850264ccdbab8d8f903669`. Reserved migration `20281012020000_client_ordered_owners`; coordinated Primary writer, backfill, constraints/RLS and native qualification remain owner work. Candidate team `ownerRank`/`ownerAvailable` and removal semantics must agree with the ordered source.
- **Newsletter staging:** [capirov2 PR2401](https://github.com/neo-capiro/capirov2/pull/2401), head `3c20f798c731403ffe2bbb6fa75dcb1bbf80bb16`, implementation `77e8323527d5ed533aa084cb8865f4b2d75f9958`; depends on [PR2400](https://github.com/neo-capiro/capirov2/pull/2400) at `6c26ac2dad3756a61b6733329dea7ce3c9138ece`. Integration document blob `2b98698db82abffcbc1ceb33c7b3b29b29153687`. Reserved Workspace migration `20281012040000_saved_version_immutability`. Shared/Core/Workspace code and immutable saved-version/request/snapshot/state-version receipts require coordinated qualification. PR2400's stack also includes Sender PR2393; none is a prerequisite for basic preview access. Staging replaces existing session content, so it is excluded from Neo's initial live check.
- **Effective dates:** [capirov2 PR2403](https://github.com/neo-capiro/capirov2/pull/2403), head `39b4ae45db578d121b18db9f95029a8c3ec293a2`, accepted source `35abc148e301b5b0b0baa4f5b284757079d9d91d`. The frontend wire pin remains `762aea0004dba51643ff370e7029de266966b74e`; the owner reports runtime/schema/migration byte equivalence while the accepted source includes its sync-checkpoint fix. Integration document blob `3766b4fdceaed13f14edcd2b8d4905ec63456b63`. Reserved migration `20281012060000` and controlled ingestion/data qualification remain backend work. Do not run sync as a browser smoke check.

Objective-bound destination receipts are additional candidate dependencies: Outreach [PR2402](https://github.com/neo-capiro/capirov2/pull/2402) at `4a784b58a0d41251ae6d7dea75a9b4858abc8665` for `GET /api/engagement/outreach-v3/sessions/:sessionId/objective-destination`; Strategy/Planner [PR2404](https://github.com/neo-capiro/capirov2/pull/2404) at `0716767e8b6ff323b2516d166b22edb4d2413e57` for `GET /strategy-api/strategies/:id/objective-destination` and `/strategy-api/planner/tasks/:id/objective-destination`; Workspace [PR2405](https://github.com/neo-capiro/capirov2/pull/2405) at `c05b85a29a75cbaaa8538fd7f9a97e298a23913e` for `GET /workspace-api/drafts/:draftId/versions/:versionId/objective-destination`, stacked on PR2401. Source review alone does not establish that these routes are deployed.

## Qualification and handoff

See [QUALIFICATION.json](QUALIFICATION.json) for exact trees, hashes, counts, raw evidence and limits. The follow-up passes 2,255 web tests, 442 Capiro/feature tests, 111 root controls, 84 transport cases, 26 mounted browser cases, workspace types, changed-file lint/format, public packages, architecture, production build and actual standalone/browser checks. The 12 new unit cases are included in 2,255, not additional. The actual server is credential-free and proves routing/rendering/configuration failure behavior, not a signed-in API connection.

Architecture retains 21 inherited unreviewed size signals, 467 exact reviewed signals and zero blocking findings/errors (488 total). The changed existing proxy function received a fingerprinted responsibility review; no guard or test was weakened. No feature implementation or original test was removed.

Dependencies were reused from the existing exact graph. The final build used a real local dependency tree: 48,026 files were hardlinked only after byte equality checks, and 450 differing/missing files were copied from the current graph. No lockfile/package version changed. This is not a new clean install. Initial missing nested-package links, an outward-root-symlink Turbopack failure and a missing default Playwright browser were diagnosed and corrected without source changes; failed evidence remains archived. The final browser run used `/usr/bin/chromium` through the runner's existing environment option. Disk pressure was handled by moving this follow-up's generated browser harness into `/tmp`, preserving its bytes and all other work.

Native login, deployed service availability, own-tenant reads/writes, sign-out/expiry against Clerk, a fresh container install/scan, a new Figma comparison and comprehensive accessibility acceptance were not run here. There is no new immutable image or deployment. No auth/tenant permission, credential, infrastructure, database or provider state changed.

Both native ledgers are byte-identical to PR25. All **337 in-scope Portfolio rows remain unaccepted** until their own criteria pass; the active ledger also retains its eight out-of-scope rows. This source repair adds bounded evidence only. It does not make those 337 rows a gate for basic functional preview access. Use the [short live check](LIVE-CHECK.md) after shipping, with only Neo's existing account/tenant and new disposable test data.
